templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-60m latest=now action=failure | stats count as failed_logins dc(user) as distinct_users min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(action) as action by host, src | where failed_logins >= 25 | sort -failed_logins | head 100

search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-60m latest=now (action=failure OR action=success) | stats count(eval(action="failure")) as fail_count count(eval(action="success")) as success_count values(src) as source_ips values(host) as hosts min(eval(if(action="failure", _time, null()))) as first_failure max(eval(if(action="success", _time, null()))) as last_success max(_time) as last_event by user | where fail_count >= 5 AND success_count >= 1 | eval risk="P2 review - successful login after repeated failures" | table user hosts source_ips fail_count success_count first_failure last_success last_event risk | sort -fail_count | head 100

search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-24h latest=now action=success | stats count as login_count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(action) as action by user, host, src | where NOT cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", src) | sort -login_count | head 100
search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-24h latest=now signature=account_locked | timechart span=1h count as lockout_count | head 100

templates.name: AWS security group modifications by actor
templates.description: Raw CloudTrail search for EC2 security-group authorization, revocation, create, delete, and modify events.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail earliest=-24h latest=now eventSource=ec2.amazonaws.com (eventName=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress OR eventName=AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress OR eventName=RevokeSecurityGroupIngress OR eventName=RevokeSecurityGroupEgress OR eventName=ModifySecurityGroupRules OR eventName=CreateSecurityGroup OR eventName=DeleteSecurityGroup) | stats count as change_count values(eventName) as event_names values(requestParameters.groupId) as security_group_ids values(sourceIPAddress) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by userIdentity.arn userIdentity.userName awsRegion | sort -change_count | head 100

templates.name: AWS Console successful logins by user
templates.description: Raw CloudTrail search for successful AWS ConsoleLogin events grouped by actor.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail earliest=-24h latest=now eventSource=signin.amazonaws.com eventName=ConsoleLogin responseElements.ConsoleLogin=Success | stats count as login_count values(sourceIPAddress) as source_ips values(userAgent) as user_agents min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by userIdentity.arn userIdentity.userName awsRegion | sort -login_count | head 100

templates.name: AWS IAM policy modifications by actor
templates.description: Raw CloudTrail search for IAM policy create/update/delete and attach/detach events grouped by actor.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail earliest=-24h latest=now eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com (eventName=CreatePolicy OR eventName=CreatePolicyVersion OR eventName=SetDefaultPolicyVersion OR eventName=DeletePolicy OR eventName=DeletePolicyVersion OR eventName=PutUserPolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=PutGroupPolicy OR eventName=DeleteUserPolicy OR eventName=DeleteRolePolicy OR eventName=DeleteGroupPolicy OR eventName=AttachUserPolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachGroupPolicy OR eventName=DetachUserPolicy OR eventName=DetachRolePolicy OR eventName=DetachGroupPolicy) | stats count as change_count values(eventName) as event_names values(requestParameters.policyArn) as policy_arns values(requestParameters.userName) as target_users values(requestParameters.roleName) as target_roles values(sourceIPAddress) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by userIdentity.arn userIdentity.userName awsRegion | sort -change_count | head 100

templates.name: Top failed-login users excluding service accounts
templates.description: Raw PGCIL auth search for failed-login counts by user over 24h with service-account exclusions encoded.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-24h latest=now action=failure NOT (user="svc_*" OR user="service_*" OR user="*_svc") | stats count as fail_count values(src) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | sort -fail_count | head 100

templates.name: Privileged account authentication review
templates.description: Read-only pgcil:auth aggregation for admin-shaped account logins (success and failure counts) with bounded time. Rewritten from the Windows EventCode lab family to the governed auth field model; does not confirm compromise.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-24h latest=now (action=success OR action=failure) (user="*admin*" OR user="*_adm" OR user="administrator" OR user="root") NOT (user="svc_*" OR user="service_*" OR user="*_svc") | stats count as event_count count(eval(action="failure")) as fail_count count(eval(action="success")) as success_count values(src) as source_ips values(host) as hosts min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | sort -event_count | head 100

templates.name: After-hours authentication review
templates.description: Read-only authentication aggregation for logins outside 07:00-19:00 (indexed date_hour) with bounded time and analyst-review output fields. Critical-asset scoping is analyst review, not asserted by this query alone.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-24h latest=now (action=success OR action=failure) | where (date_hour<7) OR (date_hour>=19) | stats count as after_hours_logins dc(host) as distinct_hosts values(host) as hosts values(src) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | sort -after_hours_logins | head 100

templates.name: VPN failed-login spike by user
templates.description: Read-only aggregation of failed VPN authentications per user with bounded time and source spread for anomaly review.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:vpn earliest=-24h latest=now action=failure | stats count as failed_vpn_logins dc(src) as distinct_sources values(src) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | where failed_vpn_logins >= 10 | sort -failed_vpn_logins | head 100

templates.name: Firewall deny spike by source/destination
templates.description: Read-only aggregation of firewall deny events per source/destination with bounded time and port spread for spike review.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:firewall earliest=-24h latest=now action=deny | stats count as deny_count dc(dest_port) as distinct_ports values(dest_port) as dest_ports values(app) as apps min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src, dest | where deny_count >= 50 | sort -deny_count | head 100

templates.name: DNS beaconing candidate review
templates.description: Read-only DNS aggregation for candidate beaconing review with bounded time, rarity, and periodicity fields.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:dns earliest=-24h latest=now | stats count as DNS_query_count values(query) as domain values(dest) as dest values(bytes_out) as bytes_out dc(query) as distinct_domains min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src | eval observation_window=last_seen-first_seen | eval periodicity=if(DNS_query_count>1,round(observation_window/(DNS_query_count-1),2),null()) | eval jitter="requires_review" | eval rare_domain_indicator=if(distinct_domains<=3 AND DNS_query_count>=20,"review","unknown") | eval user_host_association=src | where DNS_query_count >= 20 | table src dest domain DNS_query_count periodicity jitter bytes_out rare_domain_indicator user_host_association first_seen last_seen | sort -DNS_query_count | head 100

templates.name: Critical alert MITRE review
templates.description: Read-only aggregation of critical/high endpoint alerts over 6h with MITRE technique and host rollups for analyst review.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:edr earliest=-6h latest=now | eval rule_name=coalesce(rule_name,process_name,"edr_detection") | eval mitre_technique=coalesce(mitre_technique_id,"T1059.001") | eval mitre_tactic=coalesce(mitre_tactic,"Execution") | eval urgency=case(match(severity,"(?i)critical"),"critical",match(severity,"(?i)high"),"high",true(),"medium") | stats count as alert_count values(rule_name) as rule_name values(mitre_technique) as mitre_technique values(mitre_tactic) as mitre_tactic values(urgency) as urgency values(severity) as severity min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by host | where urgency IN ("critical","high") | sort -alert_count | head 100

templates.name: Suspicious process execution review
templates.description: Read-only endpoint aggregation for suspicious process execution (LOLBins + encoded/download command lines) with bounded time and analyst-review output fields.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:edr earliest=-24h latest=now (process_name="rundll32.exe" OR process_name="regsvr32.exe" OR process_name="mshta.exe" OR process_name="wscript.exe" OR process_name="cscript.exe" OR process_name="certutil.exe" OR process_name="bitsadmin.exe" OR process_name="msbuild.exe" OR command_line="*-enc*" OR command_line="*downloadstring*") | stats count as event_count values(command_line) as command_line values(parent_process) as parent_process values(process_path) as process_path values(signature_status) as signature_status values(dest) as network_connection min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by host,user,process_name | sort -event_count | head 100

templates.name: PowerShell suspicious command review
templates.description: Read-only endpoint aggregation for suspicious PowerShell evidence with bounded time and analyst-review output fields.
templates.spl_text: search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:edr earliest=-24h latest=now (process_name=powershell.exe OR process_name=pwsh.exe OR command_line="*powershell*" OR script_block_text="*") | eval encoded_command_flag=if(match(command_line,"(?i)(-enc|-encodedcommand)"),"true","false") | stats count as event_count values(command_line) as command_line values(script_block_text) as script_block_text values(parent_process) as parent_process values(process_name) as process_name values(event_id) as event_id values(encoded_command_flag) as encoded_command_flag values(dest) as network_connection min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by host,user | sort -event_count | head 100

templates.name: Cisco cleartext sessions to Phase-1 RTUs
templates.description: Review-only Firepower hunt for cleartext HTTP/VNC toward Phase-1 RTU destinations using a bounded RTU asset subsearch.
templates.spl_text: search index=<cisco_firewall_index> sourcetype=<cisco_firewall_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (dest_port=80 OR dest_port=5900 OR app=HTTP OR app=VNC) | where dest_ip IN ([ search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-7d latest=now tag=phase1_rtu | stats count by ip | fields ip | rename ip as dest_ip | head 100 ]) | stats count as session_count values(app) as applications values(dest_port) as dest_ports min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip dest_ip | sort -session_count | head 100

templates.name: Stealthwatch horizontal scan with OT asset enrichment
templates.description: Review-only Stealthwatch horizontal-scan hunt enriched with OT asset inventory lookup.
templates.spl_text: search index=<stealthwatch_index> sourcetype=<stealthwatch_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (alert_type=horizontal_scan OR threat_category=scan) | lookup ot_asset_inventory.csv ip as src_ip OUTPUT asset_name asset_type criticality | where isnotnull(asset_name) | stats count as scan_events values(asset_name) as assets values(asset_type) as asset_types values(criticality) as criticality min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip | sort -scan_events | head 100

templates.name: Cisco Duo MFA fatigue sequences
templates.description: Review-only Duo hunt for repeated push denials followed by approval using bounded transaction grouping.
templates.spl_text: search index=<cisco_duo_index> sourcetype=<cisco_duo_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now factor=push | transaction user maxspan=15m maxevents=20 | where eventcount>=3 AND mvcount(result)>1 AND mvindex(result,-1)="allow" | stats count as fatigue_sequences values(result) as auth_results min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | sort -fatigue_sequences | head 100

templates.name: OT firmware drift vs asset inventory
templates.description: Review-only OT hunt comparing observed device banners against expected firmware in asset inventory lookup.
templates.spl_text: search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now | stats latest(banner) as observed_banner latest(firmware) as observed_firmware by ip | lookup ot_asset_inventory.csv ip OUTPUT expected_firmware asset_name asset_type | where isnotnull(expected_firmware) AND observed_firmware!=expected_firmware | table ip asset_name asset_type observed_firmware expected_firmware | sort ip | head 100

templates.name: Non-whitelisted master station polling
templates.description: Review-only OT hunt for broadcast polling from sources not listed in the master stations lookup.
templates.spl_text: search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (action=poll OR message_type=broadcast) | lookup master_stations.csv ip as src_ip OUTPUT station_name allowed | where allowed!=1 OR isnull(allowed) | stats count as poll_events values(station_name) as claimed_stations min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip | sort -poll_events | head 100

templates.name: Cleartext TFTP from substation HMIs
templates.description: Review-only OT hunt for cleartext TFTP configuration backups from HMI assets via OT asset lookup.
templates.spl_text: search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (dest_port=69 OR app=tftp) | lookup ot_assets.csv ip as src_ip OUTPUT asset_name asset_type hmi_profile | where asset_type=HMI OR isnotnull(hmi_profile) | stats count as tftp_events values(dest_ip) as tftp_targets values(asset_name) as hmi_assets min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip | sort -tftp_events | head 100

templates.name: Impossible physical access vs login site
templates.description: Review-only compliance hunt correlating badge site from physical access lookup against login substation.
templates.spl_text: search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now action=success | lookup physical_access.csv user OUTPUT badge_site badge_time | eval login_site=coalesce(substation, host_site, host) | where isnotnull(badge_site) AND badge_site!=login_site | stats count as mismatch_events values(badge_site) as badge_sites values(login_site) as login_sites by user host | sort -mismatch_events | head 100

templates.name: Scan activity against CII registry nodes
templates.description: Review-only compliance hunt mapping scan activity to CII registry lookup nodes.
templates.spl_text: search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now | stats dc(dest_ip) as scanned_hosts count as scan_events by src_ip | lookup cii_registry.csv ip as dest_ip OUTPUT cii_node cii_tier | where isnotnull(cii_node) | sort -scan_events | head 100

templates.name: LOTO breaker command correlation
templates.description: Review-only compliance hunt joining active LOTO safety logs with breaker command events.
templates.spl_text: search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (action=breaker_command OR command=breaker_update) | stats count as command_count values(command) as commands min(_time) as cmd_time by host src_ip | join max=1 type=left host [ search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now tag=loto active=1 | stats latest(loto_state) as loto_state values(work_order) as work_orders by host | head 100 ] | where loto_state=active AND command_count>0 | table host src_ip commands loto_state work_orders cmd_time | head 100

templates.name: CERT-In advisory file hash match
templates.description: Review-only compliance hunt matching download file hashes against CERT-In IOC lookup.
templates.spl_text: search index=<endpoint_index> sourcetype=<endpoint_process_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (action=download OR event_type=file_download) | lookup cert_in_ioc.csv hash as file_hash OUTPUT ioc_label advisory_id | where isnotnull(ioc_label) | stats count as match_count values(ioc_label) as ioc_matches values(advisory_id) as advisories earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen by host file_hash file_name | sort -match_count | head 100

templates.name: Sample: top failed-login users (tstats Authentication)
templates.description: Stage 3K-Q1B schema sample only. Disabled and non-production.
templates.safety_notes: Disabled sample for Q1B schema tests only. Q1A validator remains the safety boundary; MCP execution gates unchanged.
templates.render_pattern: tstats summariesonly=true count as failed_login_count from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where {earliest} {latest} Authentication.action=failure by Authentication.user | head {result_limit}

templates.name: Sample: top outbound src_ip (tstats Network_Traffic)
templates.description: Stage 3K-Q1B schema sample only. Disabled and non-production.
templates.safety_notes: Disabled sample for Q1B schema tests only. Q1A validator remains the safety boundary; MCP execution gates unchanged.
templates.render_pattern: tstats summariesonly=true count as connection_count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where {earliest} {latest} by Network_Traffic.src_ip | head {result_limit}

templates.name: Sample: top DNS query hosts (from datamodel Network_Resolution)
templates.description: Stage 3K-Q1B schema sample only. Disabled and non-production.
templates.safety_notes: Disabled sample for Q1B schema tests only. Q1A validator remains the safety boundary; MCP execution gates unchanged.
templates.render_pattern: from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS | where {earliest} {latest} | stats count as query_count by host | head {result_limit}
